head: The sensor knew.
The column
did not.
body: Every GPS reading arrives with an error estimate. Most schemas store the coordinate and bin the rest.
We threw it away on the way in.

head: It keeps every
*reading's papers
slides.caption: Where it came from, how sure it was, what we already ruled about it. Nobody thanks the Archivist until a number is disputed, at which point it is the only reason there is an answer.

items.title: The value
items.sub: lat, lng, distance, whatever you measured

items.title: What you already concluded
items.sub: the verdict, so nobody re-litigates it

head: You cannot backfill
confidence you
*discarded
body: Uncertainty does not get lost in the algorithm. It gets lost at write time, in the schema.
Add the columns before you need them.
